name: PubMed & iPSC Experiment Integrity Verifier
description: Automatically verifies that every bio-experiment entry in src/data/bioExperiments.ts includes a valid PubMed PMID/DOI, Yamanaka stem-cell factor specification, and fallback microscopy media whenever experiment data is modified.

action.prompt: Inspect src/data/bioExperiments.ts against .kiro/specs/stem-cell-bio-stitcher/requirements.md. Verify that each experiment has: (1) a verified peer-reviewed journal citation and PMID/DOI, (2) explicit iPSC stem-cell differentiation lineage, and (3) both videoUrl and high-res microscopy imageUrl.
